\label{lemma-global-generation-on-fibres}
Let $f : X \to Y$ be a smooth proper morphism of schemes over a base $S$.
Assume
\begin{enumerate}
\item $Y$ and $S$ are affine, and
\item there exist integers $N$ and $n_1, \ldots, n_N \geq 0$ and
$\xi_i \in H^{n_i}_{dR}(X/S)$, $1 \leq i \leq N$ such that
for all points $y \in Y$ the images of $\xi_1, \ldots, \xi_N$
in $H^*_{dR}(X_y/y)$ form a basis over $\kappa(y)$.
\end{enumerate}
Then the map
$$
\bigoplus\nolimits_{i = 1}^N H^*_{dR}(Y/S) \longrightarrow
H^*_{dR}(X/S), \quad
(a_1, \ldots, a_N) \longmapsto  \sum \xi_i \cup f^*a_i
$$
is an isomorphism.

\label{proposition-projective-space-bundle-formula}
Let $X \to S$ be a morphism of schemes. Let $\mathcal{E}$ be a locally
free $\mathcal{O}_X$-module of constant rank $r$. Consider the morphism
$p : P = \mathbf{P}(\mathcal{E}) \to X$.
Then the map
$$
\bigoplus\nolimits_{i = 0, \ldots, r - 1} H^*_{dR}(X/S)
\longrightarrow
H^*_{dR}(P/S)
$$
given by the rule
$$
(a_0, \ldots, a_{r - 1}) \longmapsto
\sum\nolimits_{i = 0, \ldots, r - 1} c_1^{dR}(\mathcal{O}_P(1))^i \cup p^*(a_i)
$$
is an isomorphism.
statement:
Let $X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes and $\mathcal E$ a locally free $\mathcal O_X$-module of constant rank $r\geq1$. Let $p:P=\mathbf P(\mathcal E)\to X$ be the associated projective bundle and let $\eta=c_1^{dR}(\mathcal O_P(1))\in H^2_{dR}(P/S)$. Then for every integer $m$ the map

is an isomorphism, where negative-degree groups are zero.

\label{lemma-log-complex}
Let $X \to S$ be a morphism of schemes. Let $Y \subset X$ be an
effective Cartier divisor.
Assume the de Rham complex of log poles is defined for $Y \subset X$ over $S$.
There is a canonical short exact sequence
of complexes
$$
0 \to \Omega^\bullet_{X/S} \to
\Omega^\bullet_{X/S}(\log Y) \to
\Omega^\bullet_{Y/S}[-1] \to 0
$$
statement:
Let $X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes and $i:Y\hookrightarrow X$ an effective Cartier divisor. For every $y\in Y$ and any local equation $u$ for $Y$ in $\mathcal O_{X,y}$, assume the map $\mathcal O_{X,y}\to\Omega^1_{X/S,y}$, $a\mapsto a\,du$, is split injective and $\Omega^p_{X/S,y}$ has no $u$-torsion for every $p\geq0$. Under these hypotheses the logarithmic relative de Rham complex $\Omega^\bullet_{X/S}(\log Y)$ exists. Then there is a canonical short exact sequence of complexes of relative sheaves on $X$:
$$0\longrightarrow\Omega^\bullet_{X/S}\longrightarrow\Omega^\bullet_{X/S}(\log Y)\xrightarrow{\operatorname{Res}}i_*\Omega^\bullet_{Y/S}[-1]\longrightarrow0.$$
Here $\operatorname{Res}$ is the logarithmic residue map and the last complex is viewed on $X$ via $i_*$.

Identify the exceptional divisor $E\subset L$ with $P$ via its zero-section embedding into the natural line bundle $L\to P$.

For every $a\geq0$:
(1) the natural map $\Omega^a_{X/S}\xrightarrow{\sim}b_*\Omega^a_{L/S}$ is an isomorphism;
(2) the natural map $\Omega^a_{Z/S}\xrightarrow{\sim}p_*\Omega^a_{P/S}$ is an isomorphism; and
(3) the map $Rb_*\Omega^a_{L/S}\to i_*Rp_*\Omega^a_{P/S}$ induces an isomorphism on cohomology sheaves $\mathcal H^j$ for every $j\geq1$.

\label{lemma-ext-zero}
Let $i : Z \to X$ be a closed immersion of schemes which is regular of
codimension $c$. Then $\Ext^q_{\mathcal{O}_X}(i_*\mathcal{F}, \mathcal{E}) = 0$
for $q < c$ for $\mathcal{E}$ locally free on $X$ and $\mathcal{F}$
any $\mathcal{O}_Z$-module.
statement:

$$
\xymatrix{
0 \ar[r] &
K^0 \ar[r] &
L^0 \ar[r] &
M^0 \ar[r] & 0 \\
& & L^{-1} \ar[u]_\partial \ar@{=}[r] &
M^{-1} \ar[u]
}
$$
of $R$-modules with exact top row and $M^0$ and $M^{-1}$
finite free of the same rank. For $p \geq 0$ there are canonical maps
$$
c^p : 
\wedge^p(H^0(L^\bullet))
\longrightarrow
\wedge^p(K^0) \otimes_R \det(M^\bullet)
$$
with the following properties:
\begin{enumerate}
\item $c^0(1) = \delta(M^\bullet)$, and
\item $c^{q + p}(\omega \wedge \eta) = \omega \wedge c^p(\eta)$
for $\omega \in \wedge^q(K^0)$ and $\eta \in \wedge^p(H^0(L^\bullet))$.
\end{enumerate}
In particular, the composition of $c^p$ with the map
$\wedge^p(K^0) \to \wedge^p(H^0(L^\bullet))$ is multiplication
with $\delta(M^\bullet)$.

}
